content.value_statement: Apple search and navigation choices can be hard to align across platforms. This skill turns HIG guidance into practical recommendations for search fields, page controls, and path controls.
actual_capabilities: Recommends search fields, page controls, or path controls for a given Apple app flow.
Explains placement guidance for search on iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, watchOS, and visionOS.
Describes search scopes, tokens, suggestions, and empty-state behavior.
Summarizes page-control usage for flat ordered page sequences.
Explains macOS path-control styles and appropriate placement.
limitations: It covers only search fields, page controls, and path controls.
It does not provide complete Apple platform design guidance.
It does not generate production UI code by itself.
It relies on the included HIG excerpts and may miss newer Apple updates.

use_cases.title: Choose Search Placement
use_cases.description: Decide whether search belongs in a tab bar, toolbar, sidebar, or inline area.

use_cases.title: Specify Pagination Behavior
use_cases.description: Define when a page control is appropriate and how people should interact with it.

use_cases.title: Review macOS File Navigation
use_cases.description: Assess whether a path control fits a file hierarchy or document browser.

prompt_templates.title: Pick a Component
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a navigation need.
prompt_templates.prompt: Which HIG component should I use for this flow: search field, page control, or path control? Explain the reason.

prompt_templates.title: Review Search UX
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my app search design for Apple platforms. Cover placement, placeholder text, suggestions, scopes, and empty states.

prompt_templates.title: Define Page Control Rules
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a HIG-aligned behavior spec for a page control with multiple pages, custom indicators, and scrubbing support.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Platform Patterns
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, watchOS, and visionOS guidance for this search or navigation component.

output_examples.input: I have a media app with search as a main destination.
output_examples.output: Use a dedicated search area when browsing and search support each other. Consider immediate focus when quick lookup is the primary task.

output_examples.input: My onboarding has eight flat steps.
output_examples.output: A page control is appropriate because the steps form an ordered list. Keep the control centered near the bottom.

output_examples.input: My Mac app shows nested folders for a selected document.
output_examples.output: Use a path control in the window body. Choose the standard style when users need visible ancestor navigation.

best_practices: Start with the component purpose before choosing placement.
Ask for platform, content type, and dataset size when context is missing.
Keep recommendations tied to observable HIG guidance.
anti_patterns: Do not use page controls for hierarchical or nonsequential navigation.
Do not use generic search placeholder text when the searchable content is known.
Do not place macOS path controls in toolbars or status bars.

faq.question: What components does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers search fields, page controls, and path controls from Apple HIG guidance.

faq.question: Can it help with iOS search placement?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains tab bar, toolbar, inline, and sidebar-related search placement patterns.

faq.question: Does it support macOS path controls?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers standard and pop-up path controls, including placement guidance.

faq.question: Can it write SwiftUI or UIKit code?
faq.answer: It can guide design decisions, but it is not a complete code generation skill.

faq.question: Is it useful for tvOS search?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for tvOS search screens and suggestion-driven search.

faq.question: Does it replace the Apple documentation?
faq.answer: No. It summarizes included HIG references and helps apply them to design questions.
